evals.name: greenfield-no-precommit
evals.prompt: I've got a little CLI tool in this repo and it feels slow to start up. Can you set up lazy imports so it launches faster?
evals.expected_output: flake8-lazy hook added to a newly-created .pre-commit-config.yaml with args: [--apply=set] pinned to the latest tag; files rewritten with __lazy_modules__ (as sets); dataclasses left eager; tests pass and package imports.
assertions: flake8-lazy repo block present in .pre-commit-config.yaml (github.com/henryiii/flake8-lazy)
flake8-lazy hook args include --apply=set
flake8-lazy rev pinned to a real version tag (vX.Y.Z)
at least one .py file gained a __lazy_modules__ set declaration ('__lazy_modules__ = {')
no file outside the main package (like tests/) gained __lazy_modules__
flake8-lazy hook has a files regex limited to the main package
dataclasses NOT added to any __lazy_modules__ (it is used at module top level)
test suite still passes
package imports cleanly (import mytool)
a .pre-commit-config.yaml was created (none existed before)
